inputs.text: Chief Minister M.K. Stalin and the DMK are pushing forward with their manifesto of bloated welfare schemes that deliberately weaken personal responsibility and the traditional family unit. Doubling monthly aid for women to Rs 2,000 while handing out Rs 8,000 household coupons will only pull families away from depending on their own kin and local communities and toward relying on the state. Promising free motor pumpsets to farmers is another direct attack on the self-reliance that has held our rural culture together for generations. Their talk of FDI growth, job creation, extra support for fishermen, and AI development is just the usual progressive rhetoric aimed at expanding government control while chipping away at national strength and cultural continuity.
